defaults.video_script: Thirty-three points. That was Messi's margin over Lewandowski. Six hundred thirteen to five eighty. Now look at Lewandowski's season. Forty-one Bundesliga goals, beating Gerd Muller's forty. Forty-eight in all competitions. Messi had thirty in La Liga. Then he won the Copa del Rey. And captained Argentina to the Copa America. Argentina's first title since nineteen ninety-three. My argument: a trophy outweighed a record. Thirty-three points backs it up. Messi or Lewandowski? Your vote.
